title: Google releases three new Gemini models — but no 3.5 Pro
content_snippet: Google released Gemini 3.6 Flash, 3.5 Flash-Lite, and Flash Cyber, but the continued absence of Gemini 3.5 Pro raises fresh questions about its AI strategy.
title_zh: 谷歌发布三款新Gemini模型，但3.5 Pro仍缺席
summary_zh: 谷歌发布了Gemini 3.6 Flash、3.5 Flash-Lite和Flash Cyber三款新模型，但备受期待的Gemini 3.5 Pro依然没有出现，这引发了外界对其AI战略的新质疑。
key_points: 发布三款新模型包括3.6 Flash、3.5 Flash-Lite和Flash Cyber
旗舰模型Gemini 3.5 Pro持续缺席，引发对公司AI战略的质疑
新模型侧重于Flash系列，可能意在优化速度和成本

title: A physics reward is not a physics engine
content_snippet:

title: One pattern I find useful for working with LLMs is a nice long ramble session. Sometimes the LLM needs more bits to understand what you're trying to achieve, but you're too lazy to type them. In these cases I like to lean back, switch to /voice and just ramble for like 10 minutes, total mess, anything goes, full stream of consciousness. Sometimes I declare it up top, something like "switching to speech recognition sorry for any typos...". Sometimes I turn it into a small interview of a few turns. But I find that the LLMs are somehow very good at reconstructing long incoherent rambles and often their echo of your own tangle of thoughts comes out quite a bit cleaner than what you started with. The result is that you improve the mind meld and have to correct things less from that point on.

title_zh: Andrej Karpathy分享与LLM协作的实用技巧：长语音漫谈
summary_zh: AI专家Andrej Karpathy分享称，使用语音进行长时间、漫无目的的漫谈，能帮助LLM更好地理解复杂的、难以打字描述的意图，并有效梳理思路。

该技巧有助于提升人机协作效率，减少后续纠正

title: Anthropic’s $1.5 billion book piracy settlement approved by judge
content_snippet: A federal judge has signed off on Anthropic's $1.5 billion class action settlement with authors who accused the company of training its AI models on copyrighted books, as reported earlier by Reuters. In an order on Monday, Judge Araceli Martínez-Olguín writes that the settlement will provide "meaningful relief," offering authors around $3,000 for each book […]
title_zh: Anthropic 15亿美元图书盗版案和解协议获法官批准
summary_zh: 一名联邦法官批准了Anthropic与作家团体达成的15亿美元集体诉讼和解协议，该诉讼指控Anthropic使用受版权保护的书籍训练其AI模型。
key_points: Anthropic因使用盗版书籍训练AI被作家起诉
